claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.74 Project Management ZIP/log audit that regraded at 74/C with prompt artifact leakage as the highest-severity product defect.
Course-map readiness repair now catches embedded prompt artifact labels in sentence-shaped goals, objectives, assessments, activities, resources, and evaluate-design fields.
Compiler grounding sanitization now treats Course Map, Syllabus, Lesson Objectives, and Quiz & Exam Bank labels as unsafe lesson concepts for normal disciplinary courses.
The artifact contamination detector recognizes the expanded prompt-label vocabulary instead of narrowing or hiding quality findings.

Continue improving recovery so partial enrichment repairs all missing lessons before export whenever provider output allows it.
Continue deterministic texture, double-period formatting, PPTX echo, and export-panel clarity from exported evidence.
